newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU July 1-Aug 27 grain export commitments fell y/y.
newsitem.headline: EU July 1-Aug 27 grain export commitments fell y/y.

text.p: The latest European Union figures show grain export commitments between July 1 and August 27 in the new 1996/97 (July/June) campaign were 57 percent below their year-ago level, member-country officials said on Monday.
The figures, based on delivered export certificates, showed grain sales plunged to 1.905 million tonnes from 4.481 million.
Commercial wheat exports fell to 432,000 tonnes from 2.011 million, but heavy export commitments to China boosted wheat export figures at the start of the previous 1995/96 campaign.
Flour export commitments, however, reached 881,000 tonnes against 779,000 tonnes during the same period last year.
Commercial barley exports fell to 233,000 tonnes from 632,000 tonnes.
Since August 27, the EU has granted 167,500 tonnes of soft wheat, 234,324 tonnes of barley, 9,622 tonnes of rye and 7,500 tonnes of oats through its weekly grain tender system.
